newsitem.title: SPAIN: MOTORCYCLING-CADALORA FASTEST IN CATALONIA QUALIFYING.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-CADALORA FASTEST IN CATALONIA QUALIFYING.

text.p: Italy's Luca Cadalora snatched provisional pole position from local riders Carlos Checa and Alex Criville in the first qualifying session for the Grand Prix of Catalonia on Friday.
Australian rider Michael Doohan, who needs only to finish second in Sunday's race to ensure his third consecutive world 500cc championship, was a disappointing eighth fastest.

Cadalora hopes to repeat his 1994 victory at Montmelo after recording the best lap time with just three minutes remaining of the official practice session that had been dominated by Checa and Criville.
With fine weather forecast and a large crowd expected, the stage is set for a repeat of last year's epic battle between the two Spaniards.
"It's probably going to be a bit like last year," said Criville, who added he had been slowed in practice by a gearbox problem.
